//: Per-session settings for the RUNTIME assistant only. Launch with: claude --settings tools/runtime_settings.json '/roteboat'. Dev sessions use the repo defaults instead. The runtime agent writes NO files: all queue interaction goes through the localhost agent API (see openapi.yaml), so Write/Edit are denied outright. curl is allowed broadly because permission rules are prefix-matched and flags precede the URL; the skill restricts it to 127.0.0.1. The env block silences the harness's file-changed-on-disk notices (the dev session edits code while this one runs; the notices read like this session made the edits). The Read deny rules keep this session from ever subscribing to repo code/doc files -- it needs none of them: everything it must know is inlined in its SKILL.md.
